text:
Predicates:
AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenCanWatch(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(x, y) ::: x is a film in series y.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.
Premises:
∀x (AppropriateForAllAges(x) → ChildrenCanWatch(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for all ages, then children can watch it without guidance.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ∧ ChildrenCanWatch(x) → guidanceNeeded(x, parents)) ::: If a film contains excessive content and children can watch it without guidance, guidance is needed (implying the negation of ChildrenCanWatch(x) in this context).
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ¬ChildrenCanWatch(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive content, children cannot watch it without guidance.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) → AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (InSeries(x, frozenSeries) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film ::: Film('Hachi: A Dog's Tale').
'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages ::: FamilyFriendlyAnimated('Hachi: A Dog's Tale') ∨ AppropriateForAllAges('Hachi: A Dog's Tale')
